section.title: Activating CARE kV
section.hierarchy_path: /Dose management and optimization/Performing a dose-optimized workflow/Checking the parameter settings/CARE kV settings/Activating CARE kV

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Activating CARE kV

For CARE kV On, an optimized kV value is automatically set by the system. This value is set within the limits configured in the Scan Protocol Assistant and based on the examination type defined by the setting of the Dose Optimization slider ( Page 208 Setting the CARE kV limits) ( Page 209 Setting the CARE kV limits).
CARE Dose4D is activated.
◆ In the CARE kV selection list of the Scan parameter card, select On .
The CARE kV value is calculated for the next scan to be performed. This scan is indicated by a white triangle on the selected scan range.
If CARE kV is set to On, the values for Eff. mAs / mAs , kV , CTDIvol, and DLP are displayed on the parameter cards after CARE kV has been calculated for the current scan range.
For repeated scans with CARE kV On or CARE kV Semi, always check the examination type.
If CARE kV is set to Semi or On, select the FAST Window checkbox on the Recon parameter card to automatically get the window values adapted.

section.title: Using FAST Adjust (optional) and FAST Scan Assistant
section.hierarchy_path: /Dose management and optimization/Performing a dose-optimized workflow/Handling parameter conflicts/Using FAST Adjust (optional) and FAST Scan Assistant

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Using FAST Adjust (optional) and FAST Scan Assistant If a conflict occurs, the CARE Profile appears, even if it is deactivated or if no license is available. ( Page 206 Configuring the display of the CARE Profile (optional))
If a conflict occurs, the Adjust button (optional) and the FAST Scan Assistant can be displayed.
The Adjust button is displayed if the peak of the CARE Profile or the whole CARE Profile is yellow. The FAST Scan Assistant is only displayed if the whole CARE Profile is yellow.
With FAST Adjust and the FAST Scan Assistant, scan parameter conflicts can be resolved automatically.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Adapting the dose to the patient size
You can adapt the settings of the CARE Dose4D adaptation strength separately for children.
For Child, the Siemens Healthineers default settings for the CARE Dose4D adaptation strengths are Average for all organ characteristics.
1 In the Examination Configuration dialog box, click the Dose tab card.
2 In the selection lists for Child of the field CARE Dose4D configuration: mAs adaptation to patient size, select a CARE Dose4D adaptation strength, if necessary.

section.title: Using CARE kV
section.hierarchy_path: /Dose management and optimization/Considerations for Cardiac CT/Using CARE Dose4D and CARE kV/Using CARE kV

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Using CARE kV CARE kV is activated by default.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 233
5 Dose management and optimization
It is recommended to keep CARE kV activated.
CARE kV optimizes the applied dose for a defined image quality level by automatically adapting the tube voltage and the tube current.
If CARE kV is activated, scanning is performed with a constant kV value (no online modulation of the voltage).
◆ In the Dose Optimization dialog box, set the slider to Vascular .

section.title: Setting kV manually
section.hierarchy_path: /Dose management and optimization/Considerations for Cardiac CT/Using CARE Dose4D and CARE kV/Setting kV manually

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Setting kV manually
If you do not have the CARE kV option, set the tube voltage manually.
For CTA examinations, scanning with 100 kV provides images with a considerably higher contrast compared to 120 kV.
Patient weight up to 80 kg (175 lbs)
◆ On the Scan parameter card, from the kV selection list, select 100 kV tube voltage.
For patients weighing more than 80 kg, select 120 kV .

For contrast-enhanced scans, it is strongly recommended that you do not select 150 kV or 150 kV Sn as tube voltage settings for the scan. The use of the highest voltage settings leads to substantially reduced iodine contrast in the image.
If you set the tube voltage manually, you also have to adapt the Quality Ref. mAs .

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Assigning an Emergency protocol
You can set one scan protocol as the Emergency protocol with the Emergency icon in front of its name.
1 Select the protocol you want to set as the Emergency protocol on the step 2 page.
2 Click the Set Emergency Protocol icon.
3 Click OK to confirm.
4 Click the step 3 button.
The Confirmation page is displayed.
